additional_access_failure.action: No bypass/retry; already indexed individual-article text used where available.

method: Answers use prior research plus official public FAQs and municipal event pages. Every broad question remains partial unless all its subparts can be established.
Chains, individual venues, rooms, museums and dated events retain separate scopes. No cinema availability is inferred from a chain format list.
Prices remain observations, not a computed checkout total. Venue-hire prices are excluded from film-visit cost answers.
No trailer-length assumption or exact ending time is generated. Historical sensory events are not advertised as upcoming.
No product is labelled allergen-free. Public allergen-resource links do not establish local food handling.
No seat reservation, purchase, contact message, browser automation or deployment occurred.

corrections.value: The basement cinemas use a stairlift rated to 150 kg for the person and wheelchair, with no alternative route above that limit. The theatre has a separate alternative entrance. The hall/bar and adapted toilet are at street level.
corrections.reason: The earlier summary wrongly restricted the 150 kg statement to the theatre; the same page explicitly states a separate cinema limit.

limitations: Child boosters, pushchair storage, changing facilities and current sensory-event schedules remain incomplete.
Exact end times, universal trailer lengths, seat-by-seat sightlines and legroom were not invented.
Some new claims reuse known pages with more detailed extraction. New source count includes 22 online records and one local programme snapshot.
No application code, booking state, credentials, live availability or deployment changed.
